'''''Redeemer''''' was a [[Republic Fleet Auxiliary Support Vessel]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
It picked up [[Callista Ming]], [[Geith Eris]] and other members of [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis's]] heretical group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], after they decided to take up command in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In the officers’ mess, there was a brief (but memorable) altercation between [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] Luszgoti and [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Arc Trooper]] [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]].
